items.statement: Explanatory reach of molecular compatibility for yield differences
items.expected: Determine how much of the supplied outcomes the chosen computed molecular model actually explains: productive-versus-trace grouping, yield ordering, or any further supported quantitative reach. Use actual calculations on the complete sulfilimine, traceable catalyst properties, consistent physical definitions and a justified relation between the calculated quantities and isolated yield under the stated conditions. For the source triplet-energy compatibility model, donor energy does not monotonically predict yield: standard Ir at 61.8 kcal/mol gives 76%, while Ir(dFppy)3 at 63.5 kcal/mol gives 61% under matched screening conditions; thioxanthone at 65.5 kcal/mol gives 66% under different light/loading. These observations limit that model, not every possible molecular explanation. An alternative with independent computational evidence and a physically substantiated explanation of a broader outcome range passes directly for that supported scope; a new model label or fit to the supplied yields alone does not suffice. Do not infer exclusive EnT causality, full nitrene/HAA/rebound kinetics or precise yield prediction from the source energy comparison alone. No exact-yield prediction or full kinetic model is required.
